info.description:
Operations, Administration and Management API for LoxiLB instances —
authentication, RBAC, user and instance management, configuration
snapshots, and a management proxy.
info.title: LoxiLB OAM API

get.description: Retrieves all active alerts from the database with pagination (always returns paginated response)

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new alert in the system

get.description: Retrieves alert history within a specified time range with pagination (always returns paginated response)

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Checks the health of the application and database connection.
Returns the scheduled-snapshot/retention settings; defaults (disabled, every 24h, keep 10) when never configured.

put.description: Enables/disables scheduled snapshots and sets interval and per-instance retention (keep-N unpinned; pre_upgrade and pinned snapshots are exempt).

get.description: Returns snapshot metadata (never blobs) for one instance, newest first, paginated.

post.description: Calls the gateway's GET /config/snapshot on the managed instance and stores the document (gzip, AES-256-GCM at rest when SNAPSHOT_ENC_KEY is set) in the OAM database. Returns metadata only, never the blob.
post.summary: Take an instance config snapshot now

502.description: Gateway unreachable (connection error passed through verbatim)

post.description: Accepts a previously downloaded snapshot document (multipart field "file"). Only the envelope (schema_version, gateway_version, checksum) is parsed — deep validation stays the gateway's job at restore time.
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token with comprehensive license information if the credentials are valid.
Invalidates the user's token and logs them out.

get.description: Retrieves logs from the log file within the specified time range.
Download a log archive by filename
Retrieves LoxiLB instances and returns them as JSON.
Retrieves a LoxiLB instance by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing LoxiLB instance with the provided JSON payload

delete.description: Deletes a LoxiLB instance by ID

put.description: Updates the firmware of a LoxiLB instance image.
Starts the firmware of a LoxiLB instance image using the instance ID.
Stops the firmware of a LoxiLB instance image using the instance ID.

get.description: Forwards HTTP requests to the specified LoxiLB instance

put.description: Forwards HTTP requests to the specified LoxiLB instance

post.description: Forwards HTTP requests to the specified LoxiLB instance

delete.description: Forwards HTTP requests to the specified LoxiLB instance

patch.description: Forwards HTTP requests to the specified LoxiLB instance

get.description: Check if admin credentials need to be updated from defaults

post.description: Update admin credentials from default username/password to user-defined values

get.description: Returns snapshot metadata including restore history and the full gateway response of the last restore (the audit record).

delete.description: Deletes a stored snapshot. Pinned snapshots require force=true.

parameters.description: Required to delete a pinned snapshot
parameters.name: force

409.description: Snapshot is pinned and force was not set

patch.description: Updates name, description and/or pinned. Pinned snapshots are exempt from retention.

get.description: Streams the decrypted, decompressed snapshot JSON. The document contains IPsec PSKs and certificate private keys, so this is write-gated and audit-logged. X-Snapshot-Checksum carries the gateway's document checksum; X-Content-Checksum is sha256 over the exact bytes served.

post.description: Default mode is dry-run: the gateway validates and returns its plan without mutating anything. Commit first takes an automatic pre_restore safety snapshot of the target, then applies. The gateway's response is returned verbatim in gateway_response. Cross-instance restore is allowed and flagged with cross_instance=true.
post.summary: Restore a stored snapshot to a gateway

422.description: Stored blob failed integrity verification (never sent to the gateway)

502.description: Gateway unreachable (connection error passed through verbatim)

get.description: Retrieves all users from the database and returns them as a JSON response.

post.description: Creates a new user in the system with optional license key and role

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information based on the JWT token

put.description: Updates specific user fields (username, email, role, password) based on provided JSON payload. Only non-empty fields are updated.

parameters.description: Fields to update (username, email, role, password)
parameters.name: updates

delete.description: Deletes a user by its ID

role.description: Optional: Admin can set role (defaults to "user")

last_restore_response.description:
LastRestoreResponse is the full gateway response JSON of the most
recent restore attempt (the audit record). Only populated on the
single-snapshot GET, not in lists.

stored_checksum.description: "sha256:<hex>" over raw JSON bytes as received, OAM-computed

target_instance_id.description:
TargetInstanceID restores the snapshot onto a different instance than
the one it was taken from (cross-instance restore). Defaults to the
snapshot's own instance.

BearerAuth.description: JWT bearer token from POST /oam/login, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
